scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,display --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev" "pnpm --filter @workspace/display run start:headless"
scripts.dev:pi: concurrently --names api,display --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "PORT=8080 pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev" "pnpm --filter @workspace/display run start:kms"
scripts.dev:pi:x11: concurrently --names api,display --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "PORT=8080 pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev" "pnpm --filter @workspace/display run start:x11"
